contexts.text: Taste and smell meet in a certain third thing, as is evident from animals which explore their food by the smell.
As soon as they perceive as it were by the smell what is delightful to man, they assault it.

As to the correspondence of the sense of smell - to this province belong those who are in general perception, so that they may be called perceptions: to these corresponds the smell, and consequently its organ. Hence to smell, etc., in common discourse, is predicated of those who by divination come nearest the point, and also who perceive.
Genii scent in a moment what a man longs for.
That the smell has such delight, is from the use which it performs to the brain, and also to the lungs.
It is the same with the smell: odour affects the nostrils, and is in them, and is an affection of them caused by odoriferous particles touching them.
The love of Knowing the things which float around in the air, from the love of perceiving, has the sense of smell; and the pleasantnesses of this are fragrances.
At the first scent of conjugial love, they flee away.
Natural smell is from spiritual smell, which is perception.
Hence, in the Word, smell = perception. Illustrated.
When a Truth applies to that sphere, something offensive strikes their smell.
Like hornets, which, while flying, find ordure by the smell alone... So these Spirits are carried away as it were by smell, or by something represented by smell.
Smell = the spiritual perception of good and truth.
4. [end]. The organ of smell corresponds to perception.
